sources.role: closed problem, method and title-question framing
closed Abstract claim-strength ceiling and final title answer

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: problem asks whether frozen representations and compact components support useful closed-set VQA, where frozen SLMs contribute, and what measured accuracy-latency trade-offs result
claim_mappings.qualification: problem framing only; no claim that compactness implies runtime or that an SLM is necessary

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: image-disjoint GQA development design with frozen CLIP representations, compact interaction heads, latent-query reasoner and question-/answer-side frozen SmolLM2 interfaces with matched random controls
claim_mappings.qualification: orientation only; no dimensions, seeds, checkpoints, denominators or training details

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: development accuracy across nested scales and governed end-to-end warm-serial latency
claim_mappings.qualification: latency is measured directly and is not inferred from parameter count

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: compact frozen-representation heads are viable; interaction and representation affect results; increased concatenation capacity accounts for part of the original gap while the matched residual is unresolved
claim_mappings.qualification: development-only; no universal fusion or encoder superiority and no simple non-capacity causal explanation

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: reasoner configuration-level accuracy improves with scale while architecture, token access and capacity co-vary; pooled four-or-more-step deficit persists
claim_mappings.qualification: higher accuracy does not establish removal of compositional difficulty, a reasoning mechanism or cause localisation

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: question-side pretrained SmolLM2 exceeds its matched random control but remains below the CLIP-based question representation
claim_mappings.qualification: within-interface pretraining benefit; below-CLIP comparison is secondary and representation-confounded, not intrinsic CLIP superiority

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: no reliable positive answer-side pretraining advantage detected and bounded interface-specific synthesis
claim_mappings.qualification: the lower-scale 135M contrast is negative directional; other answer-side and second-order contrasts are uncertain or mixed; neither equivalence nor universal absence is claimed

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: governed measured accuracy-latency frontier contains only compact non-SLM heads; question-side SLM interface has higher warm-serial latency than frontier systems
claim_mappings.qualification: canonical E7b governed set only; no claim about all non-SLM heads, parameter proxies, energy, cost, deployment or E9

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: title-level conclusion that SLMs can contribute but their benefit is interface-specific and they are not required for the strongest measured trade-offs
claim_mappings.qualification: implemented development study only; not a universal VLM-design or deployment claim

claim_mappings.sentence_scope: conclusions are development-based and held-out evaluation remains pending
claim_mappings.qualification: no held-out result, prediction or generalisation claim

numeric_anchor_policy.decision: qualitative latency wording is sufficient; optional latency magnitudes were omitted
